DILG Republic of the Philippines DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT DILG-NAPOLCOM Center, EDSA corner Quezon Avenue, West Triangle, Quezon City http: //www.dilg.com.ph DILG OPINION No. 35 s. 2022 April 29, 2022 PUNONG BARANGAY VENANCIO SANTIDAD Barangay Sta. Ana Pateros, Manila Dear PB Santidad. Previously, the Department received the letter dated 17 November 2021 from Mr. Jonas James A. Agot, Municipal Local Government Operations Officer of the Municipality of Pateros, requesting the Department's guidance relative to the act of Sangguniang Bayan of Pateros in returning to Barangay Sta. Ana its 2022 Annual Plan and Budget on the ground of failure to justify the twenty nine (29) vacant appointive positions therein. Per representation of MLGOO Agot, you said in your letter dated 17 November 2021 that the 2022 Sta. Ana Annual Plan and Budget were returned for your failure to justify the aforesaid 29 positions. On the other hand, you argued that the Sangguniang Barangay has already created appointive positions long time ago through Barangay Appropriation Bill No. 2014- 01 dated December 21, 2013 and B-l Appropriation Ordinance No. 2020-001 dated October 5, 2020. Instead of rendering a legal opinion based on the documents forwarded by MLGOO Agot, we deemed it prudent to inquire first from Vice-Mayor Gerald S. German on whether he already knew about Barangay Appropriation Bill No. 2014-01 dated 21 December 2013 and B-l Appropriation Ordinance No. 2020-001 dated 05 October 2020 which according to you are the measures which created the 29 positions. Hence, we sent a letter dated 9 February 2022 to Vice Mayor German. In his letter-reply dated 22 February 2022, Vice Mayor German represented that he is aware and informed of the subject ordinances, however, the 29 new positions being introduced in 2022 Barangay Sta. Ana Budget Plan are not properly presented in the subject ordinances as new positions as you allegedly claimed. Moreover, Vice-Mayor German represented that the Sangguniang Bayan of Pateros was in good faith in returning the 2022 Barangay Sta. Ana Annual Budget and Plan for correction and adjustment by requiring them to submit enacted barangay ordinances creating the 29 positions indicated in their approved and budget plan. Instead of complying with the Sangguniang Bayan's requirement or filing a motion for reconsideration with valid reasons and references, you requested the minutes of the Sangguniang Bayan session held on October 26, 2021 where the deliberation of the said barangay budget and plan was made. "Matino, Mahusay at Maasahan" Trunkline No.: 8876-34-54

According to Vice-Mayor German, you believe that the enactment of barangay ordinance is no longer necessary for the creation and appointment of the 29 new positions in your 2022 budget. Vice-Mayor German and the Sangguniang Bayan of Pateros believe otherwise and invoke Sections 387 (b) and 396 of RA 7160 or the Local Government Code of 1991 Foremost, we agree with Vice Mayor German that creation of new positions should be done through the enactment of an ordinance. Further, the Local Government Code of 1991 provides that the Sanggunian shall determine the positions and the salaries, wages, allowances and other emoluments and benefits of officials and employees paid wholly or mainly from local funds and provide for expenditures necessary for the proper conduct of programs, projects, services and activities of the local government. Hence, any position created in the LGU shall be adequately provided with funding requirements for basic salary, including the associated compensation attached to the position such as allowances, RATA if entitled thereto, year-end benefits, etc., for it to be considered a properly created position. Otherwise, a position is not deemed properly created if such had not been fully provided corresponding appropriations for basic salary and other compensationl. The Sangguniang Bayan of Pateros is empowered by the LGC to review barangay budget in order to ensure that the provisions of the LGC, as well as pertinent isSuances of the Department of Budget and Management are complied with. For so long as the Sangguniang Bayan, such as the herein case of the Sangguniang Bayan of Pateros, is acting within its authority as mandated by the LGC, specifically, Article II, Chapter Ill, Title V, Book II, the Department will not therefore interfere. This opinion is rendered without prejudice to any contrary opinion rendered by more competent authorities and the courts. Thank you. Very truly yours, BY AUTHORITY OF THE SECRETARY: nderse GAN for Local Government LLLS/RPB/LRALLD/rra0/ClP copy furnished: DIR. MARIA LOURDES L. AGUSTIN Regional Director, DILG-NCR HON. GERALD S.
